$comment: The STOVE PC SDK drop that tools/fetch-sdk.js fetches and verifies (issue #21). Reviewed like code: the version is the one the addon has been built and smoke-tested against, and a change here is a pull request of its own, never combined with an addon change. Each archive is checked against its SHA-256 before extraction; a mismatch fails the fetch and nothing is substituted. The files are the vendor's and are never committed, packed or redistributed.
source: STOVE developer-center download CDN (the links behind the PC SDK download page)
